_provenance.hf_dataset_path: EXERCISED AND SUCCEEDED - this had never run before. Private HF repo rayyanshk/dunkai streamed in-memory: 490,894 dataset rows, embeddings (490894, 384), FAISS index 490,894 vectors, model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 on cpu. Retriever built a category index over 927 taxonomy labels and ranked candidates for all 11 refs.
known_caveats: faiss/torch/sklearn each bundle their own libomp; capture required the OpenMP guard added to component_agent/config.py (SIGABRT 134 / SIGSEGV 139 without it).
eda.py parse_bom_csv calls the live EasyEDA API per BOM row, so component packages are not offline-reproducible.
dunkai self-reported validation.passed = TRUE despite 11x MISSING_PINS + 11x MISSING_SYMBOL, because those are severity 'warning' (nodes.py:521). MISSING_PINS->error is pending.
Architecture agent produced 11 subsystems, not the 8 of the spec's running example.

recount_2026_08_22_curated_padcount.why: resolver.js's curated branch built its pinout as `{ok, pins}` with no padCount. capabilityCheck needs padCount to assert completeness, so any unresolved pin on a part with a CURATED pinout degraded from PART_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH to PIN_NOT_FOUND. padCount is now taken from the real footprint (never from the curated pins themselves, which are not required to be exhaustive).
recount_2026_08_22_curated_padcount.result_for_this_fixture: UNCHANGED — every count below is identical before and after the fix.
recount_2026_08_22_curated_padcount.reason_unchanged: No component in this fixture has a curated pinout. The curated table holds exactly two parts (LP103SB6F, HY2111-GB) and neither appears here, so the defect could not have affected these numbers. An earlier report claimed this fix would 'change error codes across the fixture set'; that was an overstatement and is corrected here.
recount_2026_08_22_curated_padcount.measured_with: pcb-agent @ the curated-padCount fix, scripts diag over resolveComponents(allowNetwork: true)
